description: This file defines a Java interface for writing loan schedule history data, including methods to create archives of loan repayment schedules and save them.

classes.name: LoanScheduleHistoryWritePlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface for creating and saving loan repayment schedule history archives.

methods.name: createLoanScheduleArchive
methods.description: Creates a historical record of the loan repayment schedule and returns a list of history entries.

methods.name: createAndSaveLoanScheduleArchive
methods.description: Creates and persists an archive of the loan repayment schedule.
